# Collapsible

A region of content that can be expanded and collapsed, forcing any adjacent content to be pushed down the page.
Make pages easier to scan by letting users reveal detailed information only if they need it.

Used by the <LinkTo kind="Components/Accordion" story="docs">Accordion</LinkTo> component.

<Canvas of={CollapsibleStories.Basic} />

```css
.w-480 {
  width: 480px;
}
```

### Max height

To constraint the maximum height of the Collapsible elements,
use a parent with flex display and fixed height.

<Canvas of={CollapsibleStories.MaxHeight} />

```css
.h-360 {
  height: 360px;
}
.flex {
  display: flex;
}
.flex-col {
  flex-direction: column;
}
```
